message: The other day, I found myself scrolling through our family group chat while packing our go-bags. My daughter was sending over lists of snacks and my son chimed in with his favorite games to keep the grandkids entertained. It made me chuckle to see everyone so involved, even from afar. 😊 I realized that these little preparations can be a family affair, turning a daunting task into a shared experience. Have you ever turned a chore into a fun family moment?
